_doc: EraAS 作品共用的远征入口（外界调查）。事件分两类 feature 装载：基础 feature（requireKeywords: ["eraas"]）承载默认的都市境界线探索事件与氛围描述文；dogBride 专属 feature（requireKeywords: ["eraas","dogBride"]）承载狗的新娘线及其关联事件与描述文，远征 FeatureKeywords 含 "dogBride" 时才会装入（ExpeditionInstance.Features 为 ListContainsStrict 全含匹配）。后续 EraAS 事件按内容归入对应 feature 的 featureEventIDs。阵营/据点结构（EraAS_SurveyBase，调查队后方据点，供 RequestFallbackWorker 借用临时角色）另行实装，此处只引用。EventRate 0.1 与 ErAV MIA 远征一致：平均每数小时一次探索事件。

list._comment: 基础 feature：都市境界线的默认探索事件与氛围描述文。
狗的新娘线专属 feature：该线全部探索事件与狗相关的氛围描述文。含 "eraas" 之外还需 "dogBride" 才会装入。

zh-cn.expedition_eraas_desc_1: $names$受后方部队的请求，前往都市境界线的废墟地带进行调查。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_exploring_1: $names$沿着崩塌的公路前行，曾经的商店街只剩下被藤蔓覆盖的货架。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_exploring_2: $names$穿过一栋半塌的办公楼，玻璃碎屑在脚下嘎吱作响，四周安静得只剩下风声。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_exploring_3: $names$检查了一处废弃的检查哨，值勤表还钉在墙上，日期停在了很多年前。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_exploring_4: $names$在锈蚀的铁丝网边搜索，都市境界线的风带来远处废墟特有的尘土味。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_exploring_5: $names$翻找着一辆抛锚的运输车残骸，车内早已被之前的调查队清空。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_exploring_6: $names$沿着水渍斑斑的地下道前行，手电的光柱扫过剥落的瓷砖，没有发现任何异常。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_exploring_7: $names$在一栋仓库外停下记录坐标，卷帘门半开，里面堆着无法辨认的废弃物。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_exploring_8: $names$警惕地穿过开阔的十字路口，视野良好，暂时没有外敌的踪迹。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_exploring_9: $names$踩着瓦砾爬上一处屋顶制高点，确认周边安全后继续推进调查区域。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_exploring_10: $names$在自动售货机的残骸前停了停，机器早已断电，玻璃上蒙着厚厚的灰。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_1: $names$路过那栋仓库时放慢了脚步，卷帘门的缝隙里安静得没有一点声音。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_2: 远处传来几声犬吠，$names$下意识地朝声音的方向望了一眼。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_3: $names$发现仓库附近的杂物堆里有啃咬过的饲料包装，是狗留下的痕迹。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_4: $names$沿着熟悉的路线前进，不知不觉又走到了警卫室附近。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_5: $names$总觉得今天经过仓库时，心里有种说不清的在意。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_6: 沙发上残留着几根兽毛，$names$掸了掸警卫室的沙发，在调查记录里补了一笔。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_7: $names$在仓库外驻足片刻，回想起那只戴项圈的野狗，最后还是摇摇头继续前进。
zh-cn.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_8: $names$检查完周边的废墟，日头偏西，风里带着些许铁锈和尘土的气味。

en-us.expedition_eraas_desc_1: $names$ has been asked by the support troops to survey the ruins along the city borderline.
en-us.expedition_eraas_exploring_1: $names$ walks along a collapsed highway; of the old shopping street only vine-covered shelves remain.
en-us.expedition_eraas_exploring_2: $names$ passes through a half-collapsed office building, glass shards crunching underfoot, the surroundings so quiet only the wind can be heard.
en-us.expedition_eraas_exploring_3: $names$ checks an abandoned checkpoint; the duty roster is still pinned to the wall, its dates frozen years ago.
en-us.expedition_eraas_exploring_4: $names$ searches along a rusted wire fence; the borderline wind carries the peculiar dust smell of the far-off ruins.
en-us.expedition_eraas_exploring_5: $names$ rummages through the wreck of a stalled transport truck, already emptied by earlier survey teams.
en-us.expedition_eraas_exploring_6: $names$ advances along a water-stained underpass, the flashlight beam sweeping over peeling tiles, finding nothing unusual.
en-us.expedition_eraas_exploring_7: $names$ stops outside a warehouse to log coordinates; the shutter hangs half open, piled with unrecognizable waste inside.
en-us.expedition_eraas_exploring_8: $names$ crosses an open intersection warily; visibility is good and there is no trace of enemies for now.
en-us.expedition_eraas_exploring_9: $names$ clambers over rubble onto a rooftop vantage point, confirms the area is safe, and pushes the survey zone forward.
en-us.expedition_eraas_exploring_10: $names$ pauses before the wreck of a vending machine; long dead, its glass coated in thick dust.
en-us.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_1: $names$ slows down passing that warehouse; not a sound comes through the gap in the shutter.
en-us.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_2: A few barks sound in the distance, and $names$ instinctively glances toward the noise.
en-us.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_3: $names$ finds gnawed ration packaging in the debris pile near the warehouse - traces left by a dog.
en-us.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_4: $names$ follows the familiar route and somehow ends up near the guard room again.
en-us.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_5: $names$ can't help feeling there is something about the warehouse she can't quite place today.
en-us.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_6: A few tufts of animal fur remain on the sofa; $names$ brushes off the guard room sofa and adds a note to the survey log.
en-us.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_7: $names$ pauses outside the warehouse, recalls the collared stray, then shakes her head and moves on.
en-us.expedition_eraas_dogBride_exploring_8: $names$ finishes checking the surrounding ruins as the sun slants west, the wind carrying a faint smell of rust and dust.
